review:
{
  "spec": "This change extends the Todo app to support optional due dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and task completion status. Tasks are stored in JSON with new fields, ensuring backward compatibility with existing files that lack these fields. New CLI commands allow adding tasks with due dates, marking tasks as done, and listing overdue tasks. The list view updates to display due dates when present.",
  "stack": "Python, standard library (json, datetime, argparse), pytest",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "title": "Add due_date field to Task model",
      "files": ["todo/model.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_model_fields checks that Task accepts due_date argument and exposes it as attribute.",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo.model import Task; t = Task(1, 'x', False, '2023-01-01'); print(t.due_date)\"",
      "expect": "2023-01-01"
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "title": "Load tasks with optional due_date from JSON",
      "files": ["todo/storage.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_old_file_loads checks that loading a JSON file without due_date fields defaults it correctly.",
      "check": "python -c \"import json; from todo import storage; storage.save('t.json', [1]); print(storage.load('t.json')[0].due_date)\"",
      "expect": "None"
    },
    {
      "id": 3,
      "title": "Save tasks including due_date to JSON",
      "files": ["todo/storage.py", "todo/model.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_save_with_dates checks that saving a task with a due date persists correctly in JSON.",
      "check": "python -c \"import json; from todo import storage; storage.save('t.json', [1]); print(json.load(open('t.json'))[0].get('due_date'))\"",
      "expect": "None"
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "title": "Parse --due argument in add command",
      "files": ["todo/cli.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_add_with_due_date checks that adding a task with --due sets the due_date in the model before saving.",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo import cli; cli.main(['add', 'x', '--due', '2023-01-01'], 't.json'); from todo import storage; print(storage.load('t.json')[0].due_date)\"",
      "expect": "2023-01-01"
    },
    {
      "id": 5,
      "title": "Implement done command to mark task as completed",
      "files": ["todo/cli.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_done_command checks that running done ID marks the specific task as done and saves the change.",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo import cli; cli.main(['add', 'x'], 't.json'); cli.main(['done', '1'], 't.json'); from todo import storage; print(storage.load('t.json')[0].done)\"",
      "expect": "True"
    },
    {
      "id": 6,
      "title": "Render tasks with due date in list output",
      "files": ["todo/listing.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_list_shows_due_date checks that render includes the due date in the output string when present.",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo import listing; from todo.model import Task; print(listing.render([Task(1, 'x', False, '2023-01-01')]))\"",
      "expect": "1 [ ] x (2023-01-01)"
    },
    {
      "id": 7,
      "title": "Implement overdue command to list incomplete past-due tasks",
      "files": ["todo/cli.py", "todo/listing.py"],
      "test": "tests/test_todo.py: test_overdue_command checks that overdue lists only tasks that are not done and have a due date before today, sorted oldest first.",
      "check": "python -c \"from todo import cli; print(cli.main(['overdue'], 't.json'))\"",
      "expect": "1 [ ] x (2023-01-01)"
    }
  ]
}
